reason: It's right at my subway exit, so I'd probably grab a free matcha sip one morning and maybe buy one drink to try it, but my regular spot already knows my order and I'm not switching. Strawberry cheesecake matcha for $7.50 sounds like a weekend novelty, not my weekday coffee.
objection: I already have a café on my route where they start my order when I walk in. A new place has to beat that, not just be closer to the train.
would_change_my_mind: If the plain matcha or the $4 Americano was clearly better than what I get now and they had it ready faster than my current place, I'd consider making it a regular stop.
